Submits a new FP-cert request or self-declaration through the FSD intake portal and returns the reference ID and current review status for the filing.

Fetches the fire safety compliance letter for a premises: pulls the inspection record from the FS permits database and returns the signed clearance notice the department issues once a site passes its safety walkthrough.
Submits a new request or declaration to the department's approval workflow and returns a tracking reference for the filing.

Retrieves the signed approval certificate generated when a user's access request clears the internal sign-off workflow, returning the PDF record with the approver's e-signature and the grant reference number.

Submits a new E-Efka compliance request for a person or company, forwarding the applicant's details to the central filing queue and returning a request reference number and its current processing status.

Retrieves the issued compliance certificate for a taxpayer or company from the E-Efka insurance records system. Given an identifier (AFM or AMKA), it returns the signed status document confirming contribution payments are up to date.
Submits a new request or notice to the EnvCon portal for Category A works, returning the generated submission reference and current review status.
Fetches the final sign-off notice issued when an environmental clearance review for minor-tier projects closes, returning the stamped approval letter with its attached compliance conditions.
Submits a new clearance request to the revenue body's taxpayer ledger and returns the reference ID of the filed clearance record, confirming the taxpayer's account standing as of the filing date.

Fetches the clearance statement confirming a taxpayer has settled all dues, generated by the revenue office's compliance module (CM-ClearDoc). Returns the signed PDF letter with the taxpayer's reference number and issue date.
Submits a new citizen image-ID enrolment request (portrait upload plus applicant details) to the department's identity-photo registry and returns a tracking reference and processing status.

Retrieves the citizen ID-photo credential generated at the close of the enrollment workflow, returning the signed photo card record (portrait reference, card number, validity date) for the requesting resident.

Submits a new filing for an LPG or mixed-gas fuel outlet operating permit tied to a site concession, using our department's intake workflow. Returns the generated case reference and current queue status for the applicant.

Generates the permit for an LPG or mixed-gas fuel point under a concession-based site agreement, using our internal dept wording. Returns the signed operating licence document issued at the close of the workflow.

Submits a new filing for a fuel-dispensing site authorisation, covering compressed natural gas outlets and combined fuel sites under a land-use grant, and returns a registration ID with the current review status.

Generates the final authorization certificate for a compressed natural gas refuelling facility, including combined gas-and-fuel sites, once the establishment concession has been granted. Returns the signed permit document that allows the site to start commercial operation.

Submits a new request to the e-EFKA portal on behalf of a taxpayer and returns the registration number and status of the filing. Use it to lodge a fresh application or declaration with the IT department's internal workflow (EFKA-APP), which queues the request and reports back its tracking ID.

Fetches the e-EFKA clearance statement confirming a company's or individual's settled insurance dues, as issued through the accredited agents portal. Returns the generated PDF attestation with its verification code and issue date.
Auto-fills and submits the vessel charter notice forms (small craft and motorboat hire) on the user's behalf, then returns the upload status and reference number for each submitted form.

Auto-fills and submits the regulatory notice forms for launching crop-protection chemical distribution, using the department's standard templates, then returns the submission receipt and reference ID.
Submits domestic trade fair operation notices on behalf of the user: auto-fills the notification forms with event data and uploads them to the portal, returning the filing reference and status.

Fills in and uploads the vessel-notification forms for a port reception facility ship entering service, using our internal form templates. Returns the submission ID and upload status for each completed form.

Auto-fills the amendment forms for a venue's operating notice (capacity, hours, licensed activities, premises details) and submits them to the authority portal, returning the submission reference and status.
Fills in and uploads the instructor qualification paperwork for prospective powerboat handlers, returning a submission receipt with the reference ID and status of each filed form.
Auto-fills and submits the registration forms for a new partnership entity via the agency's single-window intake, then returns the filing reference and status of each uploaded document.
Auto-completes and submits the registration paperwork for a new joint-stock company via the single-window portal, then returns the filing reference and status of each uploaded form.

Prepares and submits the start-up notification for a wine and aromatised wine bottling facility: fills the required forms with the operator's details and uploads them to the regulator's portal, returning the submission reference and status.

Fills in and uploads the online forms for registering a rental business of motorcycles, tricycles and quadricycles above 50 cc (no driver included). Returns the submission status and reference number for the filed notification.
Fills in and submits the operator's registration forms for passenger tourism coach services, then returns the filing receipt and reference number.

Auto-completes and submits the paperwork for a vessel operating permit extension for fast passenger boats, using our team's internal form templates, and returns the submission receipt and reference number.
Auto-fills and submits citizen ID photo applications through the ThirdParty portal, returning the application reference number and submission status.

Auto-completes and submits the CNG/mixed fuel station exploitation permit packet for concession holders: fills the department's standard form sets from supplied site and operator data, attaches the required annexes, and returns the submission receipt with a tracking reference.
